subject.title: [Feature]: Option to skip tool list text in system prompt (reduce duplication)

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported off-by-default agent/default config contract for suppressing the human-readable Tooling list, or should this reduction stay inside the broader tool-schema overhead design?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds a new prompt/config contract in a high-bar surface and needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Add Scoped Opt-In Config
options.body: Implement a narrow default-off option that omits only the Tooling list and keeps callable schemas, prompt guidance, diagnostics, docs, and tests intact.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Token Work
options.body: Make the broader tool-schema overhead tracker own the product design while preserving this issue as linked context until that design lands.

options.title: Reject New Config Surface
options.body: Close this direction after maintainers decide existing tool policy, Tool Search, and broader context optimizations are sufficient.

recommendation.title: Add Scoped Opt-In Config
recommendation.body: Implement a narrow default-off option that omits only the Tooling list and keeps callable schemas, prompt guidance, diagnostics, docs, and tests intact.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest inspected routing candidate for prompt construction, structured tool definitions, and the prior maintainer-side review on this item.
